0x1ed3a0: Set the color of the sun
0x1ed3d4: Set whether or not there should be sunlight
0x1ed40c: Set the direction of the sunlight
0x1ed66c: Sets the fraction of the sunlight to use for diffuse sun
0x1ed6bc: Sets an alternate sun color to use for clcing diffuse sun
0x1ed718: When set to non-zero, removes the overbright cutoff of lightmaps

lightmapFit.method: planar lightmapped surfaces grouped by normal; luxel world point lightmapOrigin + s*lightmapVecs[0] + t*lightmapVecs[1]; per normal the 90th percentile of unsaturated luxels (brightest channel < 125); for opposite vertical walls (lit cos >= 0.2, >= 300 luxels each) sunScale = (lit - opposite) / (suncolor * (cos lit - max(0, cos opposite))); shadedWallOverDiffuse = (opposite - ambientlight) / diffuse colour
lightmapFit.saturation: DM/mohdm6 sunlit floors 127 126 125: brightest channel stops at 127, hue kept

observed: no 1.00 shader has q3map_sun or q3map_skyLight
46 of 54 worldspawns have sundirection; each has suncolor (43) or sunlight (4, DM/mohdm1 both)
AngleVectors(sundirection) is above the horizon on every map
opposite-wall pairs: the sun is stored as suncolor * cos (median 0.98 over 405 pairs; 0.99 over 28 maps)
ambientlight is stored as is (each map's commonest luxel)
sunlight alone is stored as a colour (DM/mohdm3, m3l2)
shaded walls keep ~0.55-0.6 of the diffuse colour at sundiffuse absent or 1, 0.23 at 0.4, no more at 1.5 or 3
inferred: the compiler sun gives suncolor * cos in lightmap bytes where it sees the sky
sundiffuse defaults to 1 and is held at 1 or less (clamped or ignored above, unsettled)
the diffuse sun gives an open level floor sundiffuse * sundiffusecolor (the sun colour without one)
with both colour keys the later one is the colour, as the renderer reads them
unrelated: obj/obj_team2 stores ambient 35 * _color 1.0 0.9 0.8 (commonest luxel 35 31 28), not ambientlight 5.1; RTX baked modes 1 and 2 read ambient/_color but not ambientlight
